title: YouCoded name and icons — round 7: glass, minimal, the mascot's silhouette

steps.path: Website header, marketing — and help pages, where the name stands alone
steps.headline: Which name ideas do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Lowercase "youcoded" in the site's own lettering. The mascot appears only as its silhouette in the site's colour-glass.

variants.label: W1 Peeking over
variants.summary: Your A2, in glass: the body rises behind the word, just its eyes clearing the letters.

variants.label: W2 Between you and coded
variants.summary: Your A5, in glass: the exact silhouette in the gap, a hand to each half.

variants.label: W3 Icon + word
variants.summary: The classic lockup: the app icon beside a clean lowercase word.

steps.headline: Which app icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Rendered big and shrunk to true taskbar, dock and tab sizes, next to today's icon, and dressed in three other themes (each takes that theme's wallpaper and colour).

variants.label: G1 Glass silhouette
variants.summary: A pane of frosted glass in the mascot's shape over your theme's colour. Fades when tiny.

variants.label: G2 Glass silhouette, with eyes
variants.summary: G1 plus the two eyes; reads as a character even at taskbar size.

variants.label: G3 The site's mascot tile
variants.summary: The frosted tile from youcoded.ai with a lit colour-glass silhouette inside.

variants.label: G4 Peeking up from the edge
variants.summary: Colour-glass body rising from the bottom of a frosted tile, eyes showing.

variants.label: G5 The icon stands up
variants.summary: The tile is the body, on glass legs with arms at its sides, "yc" on its face.

variants.label: G6 Just the eyes
variants.summary: A glass panel in the body's shape and two eyes. The most minimal.

steps.headline: Which installer icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Same glass family as the icons. Shown in a Downloads folder and next to today's installer icon.

variants.label: H1 Icon + glass badge
variants.summary: The app icon with a frosted download badge. The most familiar.

variants.label: H2 Arriving on a beam
variants.summary: The glass mascot descending onto a frosted tile in a column of light.

variants.label: H3 Download strip, in glass
variants.summary: Your September strip-and-arrow, rebuilt as a frosted band.
